title: Research & Technical Projects
text:
Jan 2025 – Present


EEG-Based Alzheimer’s Disease Detection
PhD Research Project · FAU

Conducted research under the supervision of my advisor, developing deep learning and graph neural network models for Alzheimer’s disease detection using multi-channel EEG signals.
Extracted and analyzed spectral and connectivity-based features (e.g., PSD, relative band power, coherence) and explored graph-based representations for classification, evaluating performance at both segment and subject levels.
Designed and trained models using PyTorch, focusing on efficient training and scalable experimentation.





Sep – Dec 2025


AI-Powered Multilingual Self Check-In
Software Engineering Course Project · FAU

Project Overview: Designed and developed a secure, cloud-based patient self-check-in system integrating AI-powered facial recognition and automated appointment workflows, with a multilingual, patient-friendly interface to improve accessibility, privacy, and efficiency.
Role & Contributions: Designed system logic, functional requirements, and AI components, integrating pretrained DeepFace/FaceNet models for facial recognition. Collaborated closely with front-end and back-end teams to embed AI features into the web application, providing technical feedback and support to ensure accuracy, security, and usability across the system.





Mar - May 2024


Building an Analytics Platform for Reference-Based Pricing in Healthcare
AISIA Research Lab

Developed an analytics platform to support healthcare decision-making using Reference-Based Pricing benchmarks derived from CMS and payer datasets.
Designed a PostgreSQL data warehouse with dimension and fact tables; performed data cleaning, standardization, and relational schema design to ensure high-quality data pipelines.
Built Tableau dashboards to visualize cost variations, and provide actionable insights for healthcare stakeholders.





Oct - Dec 2023


Mining and Analyzing Customer Reviews for Hotels in Vietnam
AISIA Research Lab

Served as project coordinator between AISIA Research Lab and industry clients, managing requirement gathering, cross-team communication, and project delivery for hospitality analytics projects.
Cleaned, standardized, and preprocessed large-scale customer review datasets from Booking.com and TripAdvisor to support downstream analysis.
Conducted statistical analysis and developed visual dashboards to identify customer behavior patterns and booking trends in Vietnamese hospitality industry.





Aug 2023


Data for Change: Climate Data Analysis Education
Collaborative Project

Designed and delivered instructional content including lesson plans, lecture notes, recorded videos, quizzes, and assignments hosted on Canvas LMS.
Developed hands-on tutorials guiding learners to acquire, process, and analyze climate datasets using RStudio.
Co-authored the educational eBook “Climate Data Analysis for Beginners,” focusing on accessible, beginner-friendly data analysis workflows.





Sep 2022 - Jun 2023


Stock Portfolio Optimization using Deep Learning
Master Thesis

Developed a deep learning framework for portfolio optimization using historical data from 50 Vietnamese stocks (2016–2021).
Constructed 3D financial tensors integrating price data, trading volume, and technical indicators including exponential moving averages (EMA).
Designed and trained a BiGRU model with self-attention implemented in Keras (TensorFlow), achieving improved predictive performance and portfolio stability compared to baseline investment strategies.
